method: Ed25519 signature over the receipt body as compact key-sorted UTF-8 JSON, checked with the public key carried in each receipt. No private key is read.
claim: Signatures verify against the receipt's embedded Ed25519 public key, and every receipt uses the same key (fingerprint below): each verified receipt was signed by the holder of that key and is unaltered since. The key ships inside the receipts; we found no separately published copy (meterless.ai docs unreachable when written), so this does not by itself prove whose key it is.
note: The replayed fixtures (data/sample/model_fixtures, committed) carry the synthetic prompt previews inside their signed receipt bodies; they are kept as recorded, since removing them would break the signatures. This report itself holds no receipt body or prompt text.
